chapter: Apollo Bar, Apollo managers and Harlem nightlife
title: Mr. Schiffman hires him as Apollo musical director
summary: The Apollo's manager hired Whaley to orchestrate and rehearse shows.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And they respected your opinion because it always proved out right.
Schiffman was the manager of the theatre, the Apollo Theatre.
What was his first name. I can't think of it now.
I can't think of his name. I always called him Mr. Schiffman.
But he owned the Apollo Theatre.

Yeah, he owned the theatre and he hired me as musical director. All I had to do was take the music that they brought in and orchestrate it and rehearse the girls with the producer, rehearse the show girls or the dancing girls.
